method_notes.no_coordinate_policy: States, countries, continents, regions and out-of-area places for which no source in this build supplies a coordinate are listed with lat/lon null, method "none" and confidence "unverified". A blank is correct; a guess is a defect.
method_notes.historical_places: Tampico, Wells/Wellsdale, the schools, mills and camps no longer exist. Each carries its best-evidence coordinate with the quoted evidence and page in evidence[] and in note. Tampico is the strongest: Bob's own pencilled quarter-quarter section on the 1857 plat, corroborated by zc-sc-m09:100.
known_problems: Auto Tour Stops 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7 have no printed coordinate, section or bearing. They are chord-interpolated on Bob's printed cumulative mileages between fixed endpoints (Stop 1 - Stop 5, and Stop 5 - Stop 8), whose straight-line separations match the printed road distances to within 5% and 2%. Treat as about half-mile accuracy.

Stop 2: Bob writes "By facing to the east from this stop, you can see the crest of the hill called Smith Peak"; from the interpolated point Smith Peak bears north and Oak Hill northeast. The interpolated longitude may be up to 0.4 mi too far east.

Smith Peak / Oak Hill: zc-sc-autotour-1989:9 says Smith Peak is "Called Smith Hill today and Oak Hill at other times", but Bob's own tour map and thesis Table 2 draw and list them as two separate features in two adjacent sections. Both are recorded; Smith Peak is marked conflict.

Berry Creek: Bob's zc-sc-m08 tour map (p.26) states that USGS quadrangles have the Berry Creek / Soap Creek junction in error, west of Highway 99, and that OSU Research Forests maps were corrected to put it east of the highway after he and Neil Vanderburg surveyed the creeks in 1994. The GNIS coordinate still reflects the uncorrected position. Marked conflict.
Forest Peak: GNIS puts it at 44.6794,-123.3154, which is Sec. 20/29, not the Sec. 22 of thesis Table 2 - about 2 miles apart. Marked conflict; both recorded.

Sulphur Springs Road: the 1989 Auto Tour map draws Stops 8 and 9 on "SULPHUR SPRINGS ROAD" where the printed schoolhouse address and today's county and OSM naming say Soap Creek Road. Road-name drift, recorded not resolved.

Printed back indexes of zc-sc-m06 and zc-sc-m07 drift against the pagination by up to +2 / +7 pages (reader reports). Page lists drawn from those two indexes inherit that drift; page lists drawn from transcript text do not.
